TUR.scope: Turkey 1992: consolidated central government budget (general and annexed budgets) at about 6,872 TL per US$, plus social security institutions (SSK, Emekli Sandigi, Bag-Kur) estimated. Funds, state enterprises and local governments not covered. Tax mix from 1992 shares (income-based 49.5%, expenditure-based 49.6%, wealth 0.9%).

exps.name: Interest on public debt
exps.note: Domestic and external debt interest, 1992. The game works out debt interest itself, so this line is skipped on import.

exps.name: Public personnel
exps.note: Salaries and social contributions of civil servants, teachers, police and the military, about 79% of 1992 current spending.

exps.name: Public investment
exps.note: Central government capital spending, 1992 (13.2% of spending).

exps.name: Transfers to state economic enterprises
exps.note: Budget support to loss-making state economic enterprises, 1992.

exps.name: Transfers to local governments, funds and others
exps.note: Shares of tax revenue for municipalities and provinces, transfers to funds and other transfers; 1992 other transfers less estimated social security transfers.

exps.name: Social security benefits (estimated)
exps.note: SSK, Emekli Sandigi and Bag-Kur benefits and costs, estimated for 1992 from the 1991 total (29.0 trn TL).
